appDescription: Find all 195 countries on a 3D Earth. Three attempts each. Beat your best score in Atlas.
name: Name
signInToKeepScore: Sign in at the top right to keep this score with your account.
membership: The 193 UN member states plus its two non-member observer states: Palestine and the Holy See, represented here by Vatican City. This is a membership-based quiz list, not a list of states recognized by every country.
instructions: Drag to rotate. Scroll or pinch to zoom. You have three attempts per country. Green means first attempt, yellow second, orange third, and red missed or skipped. After three errors, Atlas shows the territory and pulls back before the next country.
rankingInstructions: Green earns 1 point, yellow 0.5, orange 0.25, and red 0. Scores are out of 195. Ties use the time of your last correct answer. The clock pauses during automatic reveals. Publish your score to join the ranking.
keyboardInstructions: Keyboard: arrows rotate, +/− zoom, Enter selects the center.
credits: Based on United Nations boundary data · NASA imagery. Generalized coastlines. Boundaries and names do not imply UN endorsement or acceptance.
